description: Poolside llama.cpp Laguna DFlash first-block oracle for oracle_no_thinking

provenance.note: The matched GGUF was converted from the pinned safetensors with the Poolside fork because the published GGUF tensor payload differs from the published safetensors payload. IDs/probabilities came from Poolside debug candidate rows; first-row logits came from an eval-callback readback of result_output. hipEngine admits B<=4, whose 12 top-k IDs match exactly. B15 remains diagnostic-only: Poolside-tap comparison reached 12/15 top-1, max KL 0.05525, so B7/B15 are not promoted.

poolside_command: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 llama-server -m laguna-s-2.1-Q4_K_M.gguf -md laguna-s-2.1-DFlash-BF16-from-b048.gguf --spec-type draft-dflash --spec-draft-n-max 15 --spec-draft-n-min 0 --spec-draft-p-min 0 -ctkd bf16 -ctvd bf16 -fa off -c 4096 -ngl 999 --parallel 1 --no-warmup --no-repack --no-mmap --cache-ram 0 -lv 5
